text:
Receive these Costa Rican

roses,


Myriam, with these

love verses


my verses will remind you

that the faces


of the roses

resemble yours


the roses

will remind you

that love

must be cut,


And that your face

will pass like

Greece and Rome


When there is

no more love

nor roses from Costa Rica


You will remember, Myriam,

this sad song

translation.title: Receive These Roses
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the roses as both gift and warning that beauty and love are cut and pass away.
